conventions.convention: Assume Countable Choice for the cotangent construction. Configuration space is Q^N, phase space is T*(Q^N), λ=Σp_j dq^j, and ω=−dλ=Σdq^j∧dp_j. The reference is the Borel measure c_NΛ_N, with canonical coordinate density c_N dq dp.

For operationally indistinguishable species, the weighted labelled reference is dq dp/(∏N_a! a_0^(dN)); its quotient pushforward includes the factorial once. The fixed positive action reference a_0 is not identified with Planck's constant. Physical observables are permutation-invariant; labelled marginals use the symmetric lift and selected-particle interpretation.
Expectations require absolute integrability; variances and covariances require square-integrable observables. A probability state need not possess a density relative to the phase reference.

Regular-shell coarea assumes full AC, a C² Hamiltonian, nonvanishing differential on an open energy band, and compact inverse images of compact energy subsets. Hamiltonian contraction is ι_Xω=dH. Shell invariance requires an actual full-band diffeomorphic Hamiltonian flow.

Physical shell gradients and areas are evaluated after explicit dimensionless conjugate-coordinate normalization. If each conjugate scale product is A, the reference Jacobian is A^n and the equations in unchanged physical time carry A^−1.

Canonical and grand weights vanish at H=+∞. Response calculations restrict the reference to {H<∞}, pass finite-valued statistics to the exponential theorem, and require local common exponential-moment envelopes.
The grand state includes a singleton vacuum sector with unit reference mass and H_0=0; its contribution to Ξ is exactly one.

The isobaric preparation uses the explicit prior dV/V_0, a unit-volume shape, and reference dV V^N dy dp/(V_0 N! a_0^(dN)). Pressure has units J m^−d. Alternative volume priors define different preparations.
Static gauge transformations use A_χ=A+∇χ, φ_χ=φ and p_χ=p+q_p∇χ, so mechanical momentum π=p−q_pA is unchanged.

load_bearing.statement: Under Countable Choice, construct Γ_N=T*Q^N with canonical form ω_N=−dλ and atlas-independent sigma-finite Borel Liouville reference m_N=c_NΛ_N. For within-species permutation group G, define the quotient reference by m̄_N(B)=m_N(Π_N^−1(B))/∏N_a!.

Adopt the weighted labelled reference dq dp/(∏N_a! a_0^(dN)) and its quotient pushforward for declared operationally indistinguishable species; physical observables are measurable permutation-invariant functions. Omit the corresponding factorial for operationally distinguishable labels.

On a sigma-finite measure space, for finite measurable X and measurable w≥0 with m({w>0})>0, assume w exp(θ·X)(1+Σ|X_a|²) has one integrable majorant on every compact parameter subset of an open Θ. Then Z is finite, strictly positive and C², ∂_a log Z=⟨X_a⟩, and ∂_a∂_b log Z=Cov(X_a,X_b); its logarithmic Hessian is positive semidefinite.

Under full AC and the stated C², regularity and compact-inverse-band hypotheses, the chart-independent weighted shell measure disintegrates m_N over energy. Each nonempty regular shell has positive finite mass; its normalized probability is invariant under an actual Hamiltonian diffeomorphism preserving a full compact band.

Relative entropy of probability densities is nonnegative, with equality exactly at almost-everywhere equality. For a Gibbs density with positive finite Z, the finite-energy, absolutely integrable-entropy functional has infimum F=−β^−1 log Z; attainment occurs exactly when the Gibbs density itself satisfies those integrability conditions. The extended relative free energy always has that Gibbs density as its unique minimizer.

For n=dN≥3 on the specified flat configuration torus, positive masses, bounded smooth periodic U, full AC and a nonempty regular full-energy shell, the position marginal is proportional to (E−U)_+^(n/2−1). On each positive-radius scaled momentum sphere, the mean p_j²/(2m_j) is (E−U(q))/n.

concerns.concern: Proof step 5.1 says 'Fix a closed subset F of a shell' and then forms dist(z,F). The cited lem-distance-to-set-is-lipschitz defines distance only for nonempty sets. The empty closed set needs a separate zero-measure case before this construction, as the opened Euclidean shell supplier does in its step 4.1. This does not undermine the invariance conclusion.

seams_checked.note: Checked both interfaces against post-csm-interacting-equilibrium-gibbs. It distinguishes the arbitrary mathematical c_N reference from the physical choice c_N=a_0^−dN, includes the species factorial once, and states the equivalent symmetric labelled integral. Its separate local-vacuum convention does not misstate the finite-N supplier.

Checked post-csm-examples-ensemble-preparations, pthm-csm-ideal-gas-ensemble and pthm-csm-spherical-shell-gas against the counting supplier. They preserve h_0=a_0, the single species factorial, operational label distinctions and the selected-particle interpretation. The spherical law is separately adopted under Countable Choice and is not presented as an application of the full-AC compact-band coarea theorem. No reverse prerequisite from the assigned pages to either consumer page was found.
